parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. A unique, case-sensitive string of up to 32 characters. This token ensures that the request is completed no more than once, preventing duplicate operations caused by multiple retries
parameters.help_zh:
幂等参数，唯一的大小写敏感的32位随机字符串。
用于确保请求完成的次数不超过一次，以此避免多次重试带来重复操作的问题
parameters.name: client_token

image_to_video: image-to-video

任务类型，必填，枚举值：
text_to_video ，文生视频
image_to_video ，图生视频
first_last_frame ，首尾帧生视频
reference_to_video，参考生视频

wan2.7

模型名称，必填：
wan3.0-video
wan3.0-video-prime
happyhorse-1.1

wan2.7
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en: The scene type. Currently only `general` is supported
parameters.help_zh: 场景类型，枚举类型，当前仅有 `general`
parameters.name: scene

parameters.example: {"Prompt":"图1在篮球场上，用图2来了个灌篮","Medias":[{"Type":"image","Url":"https://xxx/xxx.jpg"},{"Type":"image","Url":"https://xxx/xxx.jpg"}]}
parameters.help_en:
The task input. Required. A JSON string that contains the following fields:

Prompt: String. Required. The prompt.
Medias: The list of media items.
When JobType is image_to_video, this field is required and only 1 Media item is needed.
When JobType is first_last_frame, this field is required and exactly 2 Media items are needed.
When JobType is reference_to_video, this field is required and up to 9 Media items are allowed (wan3.0-video/wan3.0-video-prime allows up to 20, including up to 10 images, 5 videos, and 5 audio files. Audio and video files must not exceed 15 seconds).

The Media structure contains: Type, the media type (String, valid values: `image`/`video`/`audio`); URL, the media download URL (String); MediaId, the media asset ID (String)
parameters.help_zh:
任务输入，必填，Json String，包含：
Prompt，String，必填，提示词
Medias，媒体列表
当JobType=image_to_video 时，必填，Media仅需要1个
当JobType=first_last_frame 时，必填，Media仅需要2个
当JobType=reference_to_video 时，必填，Media最多9个（wan3.0-video/wan3.0-video-prime 最多20个，其中图片10个、视频5个，音频 5个，音视频不超过15秒）
Media 结构包含：Type，媒体类型，String，可选值有`image`/`video`/`audio`；URL，媒体下载地址，String；MediaId，媒资Id，String
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The output configuration as a JSON string. OssUri is an optional customer OSS output directory. If not specified, a signed URL for the service-generated output is returned
parameters.help_zh: 输出配置 JSON 字符串。OssUri 为可选的客户 OSS 输出目录；未指定时返回服务自有产物的签名 URL
parameters.name: output

parameters.help_en:
The task parameters as a JSON string that contains the following fields:

EnableAudio: Bool. Optional. Specifies whether to output audio (true: yes; false: no).
Watermark: Bool. Optional. Specifies whether to include a watermark (true: the video contains an "AI Generated" watermark in the lower-right corner; false: the video does not contain a watermark).
PromptExtend: Bool. Optional. Specifies whether to enable intelligent prompt rewriting (only valid for wan3.0-video/wan3.0-video-prime). true: enabled (default); false: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
任务功能参数，Json String，包含：
EnableAudio，Bool，选填，是否输出音频（true:是；false:否）
Watermark，Bool，选填，是否包含水印（true：视频右下角含“AI 生成”水印；false：生成视频不含水印）
PromptExtend，Bool，选填，是否开启prompt智能改写（仅wan3.0-video / wan3.0-video-prime有效）；true：开启，默认值；false：不开启）
parameters.name: job_parameters

parameters.help_en: The aspect ratio. Valid values: 16:9 (default), 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 1:1, and adaptive (only valid for wan3.0-video/wan3.0-video-prime)
parameters.help_zh: 宽高比，可取值：16:9（默认）、9:16、4:3、3:4、1:1、adaptive（仅wan3.0-video / wan3.0-video-prime有效）
parameters.name: aspect_ratio

parameters.help_en:
The output duration. Valid values: 4 to 15 seconds. Default value: 5 seconds.

wan3.0-video/wan3.0-video-prime supports a maximum of 30 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
输出时长，取值范围：4～15s，默认 5s
wan3.0-video / wan3.0-video-prime 最大30秒
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: The number of outputs. Valid values: 1 to 4. Default value: 1
parameters.name: n

parameters.help_en: The custom user parameters as a JSON string. This value is returned as-is in the callback result. The system reserved field NotifyAddress specifies the callback URL that is called when the task is completed
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数，JSON 格式字符串，回调结果原样携带。系统保留字段 NotifyAddress，回调地址 URL，任务完成后回调
